source: Actual Android 15 emulator recordings of this APK using owned practice fixtures. Each clip retains a single contiguous task interval, in original order and speed, with no generated UI or replaced waiting states. Synthetic speech enters the guest microphone and goes through real Cloud/Aliyun ASR. Advisor uses the production Cloud/Aliyun with a disposable QA account. No current-version physical-device acceptance is claimed.
advisorProtocolScope: Final native recording includes strict schema and 1024 reasoning budget. A later refinement only to the explicit-intent request branch leaves the unspecified-intent native request unchanged.
